text: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; rescue me from deceitful and wicked men.
Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?
let them guide me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.
to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise you with the harp, O God, my God.
Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.
